import io
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

DATA = """GPP_MtC,NPP_MtC,year
9.4286,2.4683,2001
11.053,3.5579,2002
10.271,3.0743,2003
10.132,2.9003,2004
10.007,2.8549,2005
10.468,3.1411,2006
9.9547,2.6399,2007
9.5564,2.406,2008
10.392,2.7537,2009
9.65,2.237,2010
10.03,2.4803,2011
10.058,2.5629,2012
9.775,2.1454,2013
10.839,2.9328,2014
10.954,3.1429,2015
9.8825,2.3384,2016
9.9473,2.3446,2017
10.759,2.9143,2018
11.266,3.3845,2019
10.512,2.7681,2020
10.114,2.4789,2021
9.6001,2.0927,2022
10.599,3.0001,2023
10.618,2.8683,2024
"""
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(DATA))

def plot_productivity(df):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 3.4))
    ax.plot(df.year, df.GPP_MtC, "o-", ms=3, color="#1b7837", label="GPP")
    ax.plot(df.year, df.NPP_MtC, "o-", ms=3, color="#7fbf7b", label="NPP")
    ax.set_ylabel("Mt C per year, whole district")
    ax.set_title("Photosynthesis is large and steady; most of it returns to the air "
                 "through respiration", loc="left", fontsize=10)
    ax.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8)
    return fig

plot_productivity(df)
plt.show()

import io
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

DATA = """burned,burned_peat,lost,year,forest_C_stock_MtC,agb_C_Mg_ha,clearing_Mt_CO2
13742,13739,5306.1,2015,10.988,68.286,1.8201
0,0,25833,2016,10.988,68.286,8.8612
0,0,5503.5,2017,10.988,68.286,1.8878
41.47,41.47,4631.9,2018,10.988,68.286,1.5888
28452,28420,3745.6,2019,10.988,68.286,1.2848
0,0,7114.6,2020,10.988,68.286,2.4405
106.44,106.44,3831.9,2021,10.988,68.286,1.3144
0,0,4270.8,2022,10.988,68.286,1.465
137.43,137.43,5018.5,2023,10.988,68.286,1.7215
"""
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(DATA))

def plot_losses(df):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 3.4))
    ax.bar(df.year - 0.2, df.lost / 1000, 0.4, color="#c0392b", label="tree cover lost")
    ax.bar(df.year + 0.2, df.burned / 1000, 0.4, color="#e67e22", label="burned (MCD64A1)")
    ax.set_ylabel("Thousand hectares")
    ax.set_title("Disturbance: clearing every year, fire in the drought years",
                 loc="left", fontsize=10)
    ax.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8)
    return fig

plot_losses(df)
plt.show()

name: ch42-balance
caption: The carbon balance as far as satellites can take it, in Mt CO₂ per year (negative = uptake). The missing rows are why a satellite 'carbon balance' is never complete.
markdown:
| term                                                |   Mt_CO2_per_yr | measured_from_space     |
|:----------------------------------------------------|----------------:|:------------------------|
| GPP (gross uptake, not a net sink)                  |           -38.1 | modelled from MODIS     |
| NPP (after plant respiration, still not a net sink) |           -10.0 | modelled from MODIS     |
| Soil (heterotrophic) respiration                    |           nan   | no                      |
| Clearing of forest biomass (mean 2015-2023)         |             2.5 | area yes, stock GEDI    |
| Peat drainage (IPCC Tier 1)                         |            13.4 | area yes, EF from IPCC  |
| Peat and vegetation fires                           |           nan   | area yes, burn depth no |
